course.title: Discrete Mathematics
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: In a group of athletic teams in a certain institute, 21 are in the basketball team, 26 in (10) [CO2] the hockey team, 29 in the football team. If 14 play hockey and basketball, 12 play football and basketball, 15 play hockey and football, 8 play all the three games:
i) How many players are there in all?
ii) How many play only football?
